description: The Master Orchestrator for the entire Integration Lifecycle. Trigger this skill for projects involving mobile API design, legacy system integration, or data transformations. Use to coordinate: Discovery, UI Analysis, Contract Design, Database Alignment, and Quality Verification. REQUIRES: Access to the /skills directory.
